propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is currently Anthropic-shaped in practice despite being provider-agnostic in principle, with inline provider-name branches in runner.py and hardcoded provider sets in structured.py
Bedrock-hosted Anthropic is not supported; AWS clients cannot reach Claude through rebar today, forcing fallback to OpenAI-compatible gateways that lose prompt caching and native structured output
Base URL and API key configuration exist in code and docs but are actively refused by _pai_check_config, making the documented OpenAI-compatible path non-functional
The signed verdict sidecar records only a model string, making it impossible for consumers to distinguish first-class from best-effort providers or to identify the actual endpoint
Retry logic and read timeouts are tied to the Anthropic-specific tenacity transport and do not reach Bedrock, leaving production runs (which use Bedrock) with unconfigured resilience
The proper integration point is pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook and ModelProfile capability flags rather than provider-name string matching or decorator patching
